notes: No supplied study/outcome locator or neutral description. The independently acquired named replication report identifies the focal claim as Table 3, Had Antenatal Care, HIV prevalence coefficient with country/region fixed effects. The focal replication uses new data only; the all-eligible-observations analysis is secondary and described as successful. The original paper does not print an exact p value for the focal coefficient; none calculated. Replication values transcribed from the embedded Stata output and visually verified, rather than accepted from imperfect OCR. Requested replication es_type ser_method does not name a printed effect-size metric; the printed OLS coefficient is retained without conversion. The primary replication reference uniquely identifies a report with an explicitly designated focal test; that report supplies the target identification absent from the input locators.
